name: HubSpot
appType: App on the HubSpot developer platform (OAuth)
summary: Usable right away, but capped by install count: 10 allow-listed accounts for private distribution, 25 for an unlisted Marketplace app. Getting past that needs a Marketplace listing, which requires 3 active installs and a review.

composio.note: Composio-managed works, but HubSpot hasn't approved Composio's app yet, so users accept an “unverified app” warning. Composio gives no date for approval.

capabilities.label: Read & write CRM records
capabilities.why: Works right away, up to 25 accounts before listing

capabilities.label: More than 25 customer accounts
capabilities.why: Unlimited installs only after Marketplace listing

capabilities.label: Certified badge
capabilities.why: Needs 60 active installs and 6 months listed

gates.label: Install cap until listed
gates.plain: 25 customer accounts until the app is listed on the Marketplace.

skip.reason: Your own HubSpot account is well inside the install cap

steps.title: Create a developer account and a test account
steps.detail: Apps live in a HubSpot developer account. New public apps have to use the current developer platform, built with projects and the CLI.
steps.agent: Scaffold the project with the HubSpot CLI
steps.human: Sign up and verify your email

steps.title: Define the app, scopes and redirect URLs
steps.detail: Configure OAuth in app-hsmeta.json and use the OAuth v3 endpoints. Composio BYO callback: https://backend.composio.dev/api/v3/toolkits/auth/callback
steps.agent: Write the config with least-privilege scopes and deploy it

steps.title: Sign the Acceptable Use Policy
steps.detail: Until you sign the AUP, the app can only be installed in developer test accounts.
steps.human: Read and sign it in the developer account

steps.title: Reach 3 active installs
steps.detail: Unaffiliated production accounts making successful API calls in the last 30 days.
steps.agent: Draft the outreach to design partners

steps.title: Submit the Marketplace listing
steps.detail: Needs a public setup guide (not behind a login), OAuth as the only auth method, and one app ID.
steps.agent: Write the setup guide and listing copy

steps.title: Apply for certification
steps.detail: 60 active installs, listed for 6 months, plus a demo video.

launchToday: Ship with Composio-managed HubSpot for the first users (they'll see an unverified-app warning).
Your own app covers up to 25 accounts before listing. That's enough for a design-partner cohort.
rejections: The listing redirects to another app or needs a second app to work
The setup guide is behind a login or links to a generic homepage
Asks users to paste OAuth codes or tokens
Built on an unsupported developer platform version (after Nov 2, 2026)

blockers.fix: You've hit the 25-install cap for unlisted Marketplace apps. List the app (3 active installs needed) to remove it.
Verify your domain to soften the warning to a banner. Listing on the Marketplace removes it.

uncertain: HubSpot doesn't publish how long Marketplace listing review takes. The 10–30 day range is our estimate.

checks.claim: Install caps: 10 allowlisted accounts (private), 25 before listing, unlimited after; AUP gates installs
checks.note: HubSpot 'Manage apps' page (last modified Aug 6 2026) states all four limits and that unsigned-AUP apps install only in developer test accounts.
